title: How to Choose the Best Automatic Car Wash for Your Business Type
description: Learn how to choose the best automatic car wash system for your type of business in Saudi Arabia and Libya, comparing the different systems, site requirements, and licensing rules.
coverImageAlt: A modern automatic car wash system at a commercial service station
contentHtml:

2. Types of Automatic Car Wash Systems (A Quick Overview)

The three systems we offer differ in footprint and production capacity:

  • Rollover automatic car wash: the machine that moves over the car, ideal for medium-sized spaces and fuel stations.
  • Tunnel automatic car wash: a moving conveyor that carries the car through the wash stages — the productivity powerhouse for busy sites and fleets.
  • Touchless automatic car wash: also known as a brushless automatic car wash, it relies on water pressure and advanced detergents, making it the premium option that is completely safe for paintwork.

For the full technical details and a comprehensive comparison between the systems, read WashThru's Complete Guide: The Difference Between Automatic Car Wash Systems.

3. Matching Your Business Type to Site Requirements (Where Should You Open?)

The licensing requirements for opening an automatic car wash make it easier to obtain government approval to establish the business — and these requirements are fundamentally tied to the type of site and the availability of the necessary technical and environmental conditions:

A. Fuel Stations and Integrated Service Centers

  • Regulatory status: permitted as part of service facilities (categories A and B).
  • Best-suited wash system: we recommend the tunnel system for high-traffic stations, or rollover for medium-sized spaces.

B. Near Malls, Government, Educational, and Healthcare Facilities

  • Regulatory status: not permitted as standalone projects, but only as part of a fully licensed, integrated car service center.
  • Best-suited wash system: usually touchless or rollover, given their quiet operation and space efficiency.

C. Within Residential Areas and Neighborhoods

  • Regulatory status: the site must be within service centers designated by the municipality, on an approved commercial street.
  • Best-suited wash system: touchless, given its low noise levels that suit residential areas — especially upscale residential neighborhoods. In a middle-tier residential neighborhood, however, an automatic rollover car wash tends to be the better fit.

4. A Candid Assessment of Business Types (Based on Current Realities)

To help guide your investment, here is a direct assessment of the odds of success and ease of licensing:

  1. Fuel stations: the safest and fastest business type to get licensed.
  2. Malls: an excellent investment, but one that requires a higher setup budget to provide a fully integrated service center.
  3. Residential areas: the hardest to license; municipalities are very strict about preventing disturbance within neighborhoods.
  4. Transport companies: a very promising sector, and its internal licensing is usually faster.

6. Frequently Asked Questions About Opening an Automatic Car Wash in Saudi Arabia

Still have questions? Go through the following questions to get an answer to whatever's on your mind:

Can I obtain a car wash license first and then look for a site later?

No. Approval depends on the site's classification first. A car wash business license cannot be issued without a site contract that meets municipal requirements and an approved layout. The correct order is to first verify the land classification, then sign a preliminary contract, then submit the application through the Balady platform.

Can a car wash be added as a secondary activity within an existing commercial registration?

Yes, provided the original business activity is classified under "vehicle services." If the primary business is unrelated to vehicles (a restaurant or a retail store, for example), you will need to amend the registration or obtain a separate license in line with updated municipal requirements.

Do requirements differ between cities (Riyadh, Jeddah, Dammam)?

The general requirements are regulated uniformly by the Ministry of Municipal, Rural Affairs and Housing, but the strictness of enforcement varies in:

  • Water recycling: major cities (such as Riyadh and Jeddah) require recycling units at specified ratios.
  • Building code: some municipalities may impose aesthetic standards for facades that match the visual identity of the area.

Is a water recycling system required in all systems?

Yes, a water recycling system has become a mandatory requirement in most new licenses in major cities. This system doesn't just make approval easier — it also reduces water operating costs and improves the facility's environmental rating.

Can an automatic car wash operate without permanent staff?

An automatic car wash significantly reduces reliance on labor, but that doesn't mean "zero human involvement." At a minimum, you will need a receptionist, an operator to monitor performance and chemical quality, and a routine maintenance team to keep operations from stalling.

How long does it typically take to get approvals?

In smooth cases with compliant layouts, the process takes 2 to 6 weeks. It can take longer if there are traffic-related concerns about the site's entrances and exits, or if the engineering plan needs revision.

Does noise affect municipal approval?

Yes, it's a decisive factor, especially near hospitals and schools. Tunnel systems tend to produce more noise than other systems, so the site should be chosen with the Balady platform's permitted decibel levels for commercial and residential areas in mind.

Can an automatic car wash be relocated from one site to another later?

Relocation is technically possible but very costly, as it requires dismantling the structure, rebuilding new infrastructure, and issuing a new municipal license for the new site. That's why choosing your first site is a long-term strategic decision.

What is the most common mistake investors make when opening a car wash?

The biggest mistake is starting to purchase equipment or signing a binding lease before obtaining "preliminary approval" from the municipality and confirming that the site meets the technical requirements for 2026.
